findings.evidence: `For the full list of upcoming adjustments, check the current station closures.`
findings.fix: Make the link text, surrounding sentence, and destination URL consistent (e.g., link to a station-closures page with text describing closures, or an adjustments page with matching text).

The label text tells users the field is required, but the `<input>` has neither a `required` attribute nor `aria-required="true"`, so assistive technology and browser validation won't enforce or announce it as required.

findings.fix: Remove the static `aria-invalid="true"` and set it dynamically only after validation fails.
findings.violation: `aria-invalid="true"` is hardcoded in the markup, so screen readers will announce the field as invalid immediately on page load, before the user has typed anything or submitted the form.
